name: Reeve
note: A stub (#198): their map line as the fallback bark, one ambient group, a two-node conversation. Michael, or a writing session, fills the rest.

lines: There ought to be a meeting about this.
I have the keys and no one to give them to.

say: I keep the keys, the roll, and the accounts.
The roll is shorter every day.
I do. It has forty names and a great many crossings out.
I do not cross out the ones who might come back.
